reported.quote: Our consolidated revenue was Rs.58,500 Crores, growing at about 5.7% sequentially.
Our consolidated EBITDAaL was at Rs.29,800 Crores, this is a growth of 4.2% and the margin stood at 51%.
Capex for the quarter was about Rs.13,390 Crores
Airtel business revenue came in at about Rs.5670 Crores, growing 3.2% sequentially and nearly 12% over last year.
Our ARPU for the quarter came in at Rs.264, which also had the benefit of an extra day during the quarter.
We delivered another quarter of strong performance with revenue at Rs.2510 Crores growing 4% sequentially.
EBITDAaL for the quarter came in at about Rs.1210 Crores with a margin of 48.2%.
